subject: Arch9 plane word7 is reserved; current golden omits the mismatching word
body:
New exact source-derived arch9 compatibility finding. Common nord2_texture_resources.h n2t_pack_layout and n2t_plane_pack write plane word7=(width-1)|((height-1)<<16). This exists in Mesa v10.xml GENERIC_PLANE/ASTC planes, but pinned v9.xml812..820 GENERIC_PLANE and ASTC2D through835 have no fields at word7. Generatedv9_pack.h sets opaque[7]=0 and unpack explicitly warns Invalid field of Generic Plane unpacked at word7 when nonzero.

Independent integration helper n2mb_v9_golden.c documents this and intentionally compares ONLY first28bytes of plane to v9; remainingword is tested againstv10. Therefore current PASS is partialarch9 comparison, not completearch9 descriptor parity. Please make NEW sharedarch9/v2 payload word7 zero and test all32bytes via actual v9 pack/unpack for generic+ASTC. Preserve legacy qualified bytes separately unless root chooses to change/requalify oldpath. A passingold2Dpixelprobe does not establish richerarray/mip/3D descriptors can use arch10reservedfields. No hardwarefault is claimed; mismatch and missingtest are demonstrable from pinnedtargetschema. Root has resumedtextures; scope remains your commonhelper.

Keep comparison comments truthful: test docstring/STATUS currently still lead with v10golden, while partialv9 only coverswords0..6. Do not mask expectedword7 to hide the mismatch. No build or productionedit by audit.
